request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model shown in the attached reference images. Realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, even neutral illumination, exact material colors and original proportions. Preserve all original side-specific features. One subject and one view only, not a montage or multi-view sheet. Keep the complete silhouette and every extremity inside the canvas with generous transparent margin on all sides. Transparent RGBA background, no environment, floor plane or cast floor shadow, no text or publisher marks. No redesigned details, extra equipment or new body parts. Static image only.

Subject: male Commander Shepard wearing the complete Reckoner Knight armor from Mass Effect 3, the original Kingdoms of Amalur promotional bonus armor. Use the THIRD figure in the FIRST reference as the exact frontal standing pose, with the second reference clarifying the torso, helmet and materials. Preserve deep navy-blue panels, worn dull silver/bronze metal borders, the closed medieval-inspired technological helmet, narrow dark visor, overlapping riveted chest and abdomen plates, black underlayers, diagonal black belt straps, heavy gauntlets, the original skull-faced ornament on the character's RIGHT shoulder (viewer-left), and the original spikes on the character's LEFT shoulder (viewer-right). Preserve skull-like knee guards and the full layered armored boots as documented in the first reference. Arms relaxed and hands empty. One male full-body armored figure, not four views. Do not substitute fantasy armor, N7 armor, the female mesh, a redesign, a weapon or a different color scheme.
